surface.$description: The page, and what sits on it: a field, a dialog

raised.$description: What sits above the page: a menu, a dialog. In dark it is lighter than the page, since a shadow does not show there

fill.$description: A neutral tint: a control under the pointer, a disabled field

lineStrong.$description: The edge of a control: at least 3:1 against the surface, as WCAG asks of a control's boundary

accentTint.$description: A ground tinted with the accent: a callout. Every text and link on it keeps 4.5:1

danger.$description: An error: a field whose value is not valid

dangerTint.$description: A ground tinted with the danger: a callout that warns. Every text and link on it keeps 4.5:1

clear.$description: Nothing: a colour that is not there

shade.$description: What a modal dialog lays over the page

shadow.$description: The colour of a raised surface's shadow: clear in dark, where the lighter ground sets it apart
